warnings: No ASME/ANSI/ISO/DIN standard designation is printed. Third-angle projection and inch units are explicit; drawing_standard is intentionally blank.

The left-end profile requires clarification before manufacture: .094 axial bevel extent at 30° to the axis on diameter 1.247 implies an end diameter of approximately 1.1385, not 1.188. Conversely, a transition from 1.247 to 1.188 at 30° requires approximately .0511 axial length. The 1.188 extension lines also align with the depicted end bevel tip. Confirm whether 1.188 controls only the groove root or also the end tip, and confirm the .094 feature application. Printed numeric values themselves are legible.

The groove is interpreted as a .062-wide flat root centered .250 left of the main-body shoulder, with two 30° flanks. This follows the CENT. note and profile; resolve together with the left-end diameter application.

Tapped-hole callout specifies #10-32 and .38 tapped depth only. Thread class, explicit thread standard, tap-drill diameter, total drilled depth, and drill point angle are absent. The depicted conical drill bottom does not supply a numeric drill angle.
Hole diameter .190 is the nominal #10 thread major diameter, not a drilled-hole diameter. Hole-callout depth .38 records the tapped depth.
No explicit GD&T feature control frames, datum identifiers, REF dimensions, surface roughness, or coating requirements are present.

Stamp instruction: STAMP 'SB-12010' on the main-body cylindrical surface at the indicated leader location. Character size, marking depth, orientation, and exact position are unspecified; no arbitrary engraving feature has been added.
Material note reads MAT'L. 4150, R/C 40–45. No additional heat-treatment process is specified.
Title block additionally states MODEL No. 220-B, date March 26, 1979, sheet size B, sheet 1 of 1, and scale FULL. The B in model 220-B is not a drawing revision.
Angular dimensions and angular tolerances are in degrees. The tool schema only permits length-unit labels, so their unit fields use inch while their notes explicitly identify degrees.
Derived dimensions are nominal arithmetic results, not additional independently toleranced drawing requirements.
The .030 R. MAX. note is a maximum-radius requirement; selecting .030 as the CAD radius would be a modeling choice, not an explicitly specified nominal.
For the end-view hole location, x_position/y_position are center-referenced; instance_positions [[1,1]] use the lower-left corner of the 2.000-diameter end-view bounding square.
